brief:
Donald Trump's envoys are in Cairo on Sunday for talks with Egyptian, Qatari and Turkish mediators aimed at advancing the U.S. president's Gaza peace plan, according to Al-Monitor. A diplomatic source confirmed the meeting as part of Washington's push to make progress on its proposal for resolving the conflict.

The gathering assembles three key regional powers known for their mediation roles in Middle East disputes. The timing of the talks underscores the Trump administration's diplomatic effort to broker a settlement, even as Israeli military operations continue in Gaza. The involvement of Egypt, Qatar and Turkey reflects their established positions as crucial players in any negotiated resolution to the conflict.

title: Trump envoys meet mediators in Cairo to advance Gaza peace plan
